sources.title: Advisory Futarchy
sources.author: Robin Hanson
sources.description: Hanson considers decision markets that advise executives without binding them. He discusses selection bias, advance timing commitments and participation by informed decision makers as design conditions.
sources.boundary: Full public article body read. Theoretical design arguments are not empirical validation of Bench or MetaDAO. Comments are not attributed to Hanson.

sources.title: Opportunity Markets
sources.author: Dave White and Matt Liston
sources.description: Proposes sponsor-funded private markets to reward people who discover opportunities. Discusses delayed position visibility, collateral design and sponsor self-dealing risks; the design remains dependent on trust and reputation.
sources.boundary: Full publisher article body read, including mechanism and exploitation limits. Original dated URL redirects to the canonical writing path. Conceptual background cited in Ownership Radio 12, not evidence of a MetaDAO raise.

sources.title: Introducing Bench: Opportunity Markets for Private, High-Conviction Insight
sources.author: Arcium
sources.description: Arcium introduces Bench’s Solana devnet alpha: participants stake on options and the market creator chooses useful signals for rewards. The article explains private information, proportional payouts and no slashing.
sources.boundary: Full partner-publisher article body read. Privacy and first-of-kind claims are attributed, not independently audited. Explicitly a devnet launch; no completed MetaDAO fundraising established.

scope: Background explicitly raised in Radio 12; does not imply full recording review or new ecosystem-project membership.
